title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode6 Come See My Show!

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line: Great! That's perfect! I hope we get the chance to work together again soon!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for today. I look forward to the next shoot.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Shizuku, your dance lessons for the new song are going to start soon. We should get going.

rows.Speaker: Trainer
rows.Line: All right, that's enough for today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next up I've got the radio recording, then it's...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, where's my towel? Did I leave it in the locker room?

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line:
Shizuku got another solo photo shoot for a magazine cover.
This is clearly favoritism.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess a pretty face is all they care about.
We're clearly better at singing and dancing than she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, have you seen my towel around anywhere?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there it is. Well, see you later. I hope our next show goes well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was good! I think you've finally got your introduction down!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You really think so? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm guessing you've done head shots, right?
How do they look?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yes! Um, here. I can show you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Going for the natural look, huh? I like it.
These should be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't forget to work on the real thing, though. You don't want the people doing the interview to think you look completely different in person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
All the other girls are always so pretty, though.
Both in their photos and in person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now I'm starting to get nervous.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wish I could be as pretty as you, Hinomori.
Then I wouldn't have to be so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't become an idol simply because of looks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You have to have heart as well. Having the desire to work hard for your fans—that is the most important thing an idol can have.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At least, that's what someone taught me a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Heh. Sorry for getting so serious all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you're wonderful just the way you are, Minori. All you have to do is believe in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good work, Minori. You were really working hard today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Make sure you spend some extra time on the steps you kept missing today. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I may have twisted my ankle a bit on that last part. It's not bad, though. I'm sure it'll be fine in no time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good. It doesn't look swollen. You may want to put a cold compress on it just to be safe, though.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, it's great that you're working so hard, but just make sure you don't overdo it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka is so amazing. Not only is she pretty, but she's kind as well.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The more I get to know her, the more I want to be an idol just like her!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I had planned on waiting in this world for you, but I started getting worried that you might all be feeling a bit down.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'd love for all of you to come watch our show! I'm sure you'll feel better afterward!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just take a look at your playlist! SEKAI will be waiting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's GOTTA be some new kind of advertisement.
Sure seems real.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She mentioned SEKAI. I'm pretty sure she said the same thing last time, too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, she said to look at my playlist...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? There's a song here called Untitled.
I wonder what it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Untitled? As in, it doesn't have a name?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You think she meant for us to listen to this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wahh?! My phone is lighting up!
